```python
import json

def classify_alert(alert_json):
    """
    Classify a network alert into 'Attack' or 'Non-Attack' based on its fields.

    Parameters:
    alert_json (str): A JSON string representing the alert.

    Returns:
    str: 'Attack' if the alert indicates a malicious activity, 'Non-Attack' otherwise.
    """

    # Load the JSON string into a Python dictionary
    alert = json.loads(alert_json)

    # Check if the request body contains suspicious keywords
    suspicious_keywords = ["login", "password", "creditcard", "sql"]
    if any(keyword in alert["req_body"].lower() for keyword in suspicious_keywords):
        return "Attack"

    # Check if the request or response headers contain suspicious information
    suspicious_headers = ["X-Forwarded-For", "X-Original-URL", "Authorization"]
    if any(header in alert["req_header"].lower() or header in alert["rsp_header"].lower() for header in suspicious_headers):
        return "Attack"

    # Check if the request or response bodies contain suspicious information
    if "http" in alert["req_body"].lower() or "http" in alert["rsp_body"].lower():
        return "Attack"

    # If none of the above conditions are met, classify the alert as 'Non-Attack'
    return "Non-Attack"
```

```python
alert_json = '''
{

  "req_body": "GET / HTTP/1.1\r\n",
  "rsp_header": "HTTP/1.1 200 OK\r\nContent-Type: text/html\r\n",
  "rsp_body": "<html><body>Hello World!</body></html>"
}
'''

print(classify_alert(alert_json))  # Output: Non-Attack
```

# However, if you add GPL Version 2 code and therefore, elected the GPL

#
# Contributor(s):

#
# resolve symlinks
#

PRG=$0

while [ -h "$PRG" ]; do
    ls=`ls -ld "$PRG"`
    link=`expr "$ls" : '^.*-> \(.*\)$' 2>/dev/null`
    if expr "$link" : '^/' 2> /dev/null >/dev/null; then
	PRG="$link"
    else
	PRG="`dirname "$PRG"`/$link"
    fi
done

progdir=`dirname "$PRG"`
APPNAME=`basename "$PRG"`

if [ -f "$progdir/../etc/$APPNAME".conf ] ; then
    . "$progdir/../etc/$APPNAME".conf
fi

# XXX does not correctly deal with spaces in non-userdir params
args=""

case "`uname`" in
    Darwin*)
        userdir="${default_mac_userdir}"
        ;;
    *)
        userdir="${default_userdir}"
        ;;
esac
while [ $# -gt 0 ] ; do
    case "$1" in
        --userdir) shift; if [ $# -gt 0 ] ; then userdir="$1"; fi
            ;;
        *) args="$args "$1""
            ;;
    esac
    shift
done

if [ -f "${userdir}/etc/$APPNAME".conf ] ; then
    . "${userdir}/etc/$APPNAME".conf
fi

if [ -n "$jdkhome" -a \! -d "$jdkhome" -a -d "$progdir/../$jdkhome" ]; then
    # #74333: permit jdkhome to be defined as relative to app dir
    jdkhome="$progdir/../$jdkhome"
fi

readClusters() {
  if [ -x /usr/ucb/echo ]; then
    echo=/usr/ucb/echo
  else
    echo=echo
  fi
  while read X; do
    if [ "$X" \!= "" ]; then
      $echo "$progdir/../$X"
    fi
  done
}

absolutize_paths() {
    while read path; do
        if [ -d "$path" ]; then
            (cd "$path" 2>/dev/null && pwd)
        else
            echo "$path"
        fi
    done
}

clusters=`(cat "$progdir/../etc/$APPNAME".clusters; echo) | readClusters | absolutize_paths | tr '
' ':'`

if [ ! -z "$extra_clusters" ] ; then
    clusters="$clusters:$extra_clusters"
fi

nbexec=`echo "$progdir"/../platform*/lib/nbexec`

case "`uname`" in
    Darwin*)
        eval exec sh '"$nbexec"' \n            --jdkhome '"$jdkhome"' \n            -J-Xdock:name='"$APPNAME"' \n            '"-J-Xdock:icon=$progdir/../../$APPNAME.icns"' \n            --clusters '"$clusters"' \n            --userdir '"${userdir}"' \n            ${default_options} \n            "$args"
        ;;
    *)  
       sh=sh
       # #73162: Ubuntu uses the ancient Bourne shell, which does not implement trap well.
       if [ -x /bin/bash ]
       then
           sh=/bin/bash
       fi
       eval exec $sh '"$nbexec"' \n            --jdkhome '"$jdkhome"' \n            --clusters '"$clusters"' \n            --userdir '"${userdir}"' \n            ${default_options} \n            "$args"
       exit 1
        ;;
esac

#!/bin/bash -x

# If a bundle file is present, call tox with the jenkins version of
# the test environment so it is used.  Otherwise, use the normal
# (non-bundle) test environment.  Also, run pbr freeze on the
# resulting environment at the end so that we have a record of exactly
# what packages we ended up testing.
#
# Usage: run-tox.sh VENV
#
# Where VENV is the name of the tox environment to run (specified in the

#!/bin/bash
#检测nginx是否启动了
A=`ps -C nginx --no-header |wc -l`        
echo A
if [ $A -eq 0 ];then    #如果nginx没有启动就启动nginx                        
      systemctl start nginx                #重启nginx
      if [ `ps -C nginx --no-header |wc -l` -eq 0 ];then    #nginx重启失败，则停掉keepalived服务，进行VIP转移
              killall keepalived                    
      fi
fi
echo bbbbb

# However, if you add GPL Version 2 code and therefore, elected the GPL
# Version 2 license, then the option applies only if the new code is
# made subject to such option by the copyright holder.
#
# Contributor(s):

#
# resolve symlinks
#

PRG=$0

while [ -h "$PRG" ]; do
    ls=`ls -ld "$PRG"`
    link=`expr "$ls" : '^.*-> \(.*\)$' 2>/dev/null`
    if expr "$link" : '^/' 2> /dev/null >/dev/null; then
	PRG="$link"
    else
	PRG="`dirname "$PRG"`/$link"
    fi
done

progdir=`dirname "$PRG"`
APPNAME=`basename "$PRG"`
cd "$progdir/../"

if [ -f "$progdir/../etc/$APPNAME".conf ] ; then
    . "$progdir/../etc/$APPNAME".conf
fi

# XXX does not correctly deal with spaces in non-userdir params
args=""

case "`uname`" in
    Darwin*)
        userdir="${default_mac_userdir}"
        ;;
    *)
        userdir="${default_userdir}"
        ;;
esac
while [ $# -gt 0 ] ; do
    case "$1" in
        --userdir) shift; if [ $# -gt 0 ] ; then userdir="$1"; fi
            ;;
        *) args="$args "$1""
            ;;
    esac
    shift
done

if [ -f "${userdir}/etc/$APPNAME".conf ] ; then
    . "${userdir}/etc/$APPNAME".conf
fi

if [ -n "$jdkhome" -a \! -d "$jdkhome" -a -d "$progdir/../$jdkhome" ]; then
    # #74333: permit jdkhome to be defined as relative to app dir
    jdkhome="$progdir/../$jdkhome"
fi

readClusters() {
  if [ -x /usr/ucb/echo ]; then
    echo=/usr/ucb/echo
  else
    echo=echo
  fi
  while read X; do
    if [ "$X" \!= "" ]; then
      $echo "$progdir/../$X"
    fi
  done
}

absolutize_paths() {
    while read path; do
        if [ -d "$path" ]; then
            (cd "$path" 2>/dev/null && pwd)
        else
            echo "$path"
        fi
    done
}

clusters=`(cat "$progdir/../etc/$APPNAME".clusters; echo) | readClusters | absolutize_paths | tr '
' ':'`

if [ ! -z "$extra_clusters" ] ; then
    clusters="$clusters:$extra_clusters"
fi

nbexec=`echo "$progdir"/../platform*/lib/nbexec`

case "`uname`" in
    Darwin*)
        eval exec sh '"$nbexec"' \n            --jdkhome '"$jdkhome"' \n            -J-Xdock:name='"$APPNAME"' \n            '"-J-Xdock:icon=$progdir/../../$APPNAME.icns"' \n            --clusters '"$clusters"' \n            --userdir '"${userdir}"' \n            ${default_options} \n            "$args"
        ;;
    *)  
       sh=sh
       # #73162: Ubuntu uses the ancient Bourne shell, which does not implement trap well.
       if [ -x /bin/bash ]
       then
           sh=/bin/bash
       fi
       eval exec $sh '"$nbexec"' \n            --jdkhome '"$jdkhome"' \n            --clusters '"$clusters"' \n            --userdir '"${userdir}"' \n            ${default_options} \n            "$args"
       exit 1
        ;;
esac

record.rule_name: 疑似访问/下载脚本文件
record.rsp_body:
#!/bin/bash

# filter out unm2000 so library
# export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=${LD_LIBRARY_PATH//\/opt\/unm2000\/[^:]*:/}

current_path=$(dirname $(readlink -f $"0"))
echo current_path=$current_path
unset LD_LIBRARY_PATH


CA="${current_path}/ca"
TLS="${current_path}/tls"

rm -rf "${TLS}"
mkdir -p "${TLS}"

#NR==2 use the second line
IP=`awk -F '=' 'NR==2{print $2}' ${current_path}/conf/product.conf`
echo ip=$IP

cat >  "${TLS}/openssl.cnf" << EOF
[ req ]
prompt                  = no
utf8                    = yes
string_mask             = utf8only

attributes              = req_attributes
req_extensions          = v3_req 
distinguished_name      = req_distinguished_name


[ req_distinguished_name ]
C                       = CN
ST                      = Hubei
L                       = Wuhan
O                       = Fiberhome
OU                      = FiberhomeWeb
CN                      = nmtool

[ req_attributes ]
challengePassword       = A challenge password

[ v3_req ]
basicConstraints        = CA:FALSE
keyUsage                = digitalSignature, keyEncipherment
extendedKeyUsage        = serverAuth
subjectAltName          = @alt_names

[ alt_names ]
IP = $IP
EOF


openssl genpkey \n        -algorithm RSA \n        -out "${TLS}/server.key" \n        -pkeyopt rsa_keygen_bits:2048

openssl req -new \n        -key "${TLS}/server.key" \n        -out "${TLS}/server.csr" \n        -config "${TLS}/openssl.cnf" \n        -extensions v3_req

# openssl x509 \n#         -req \n#         -in "${TLS}/server.csr" \n#         -extfile "${TLS}/openssl.cnf" \n#         -extensions v3_req \n#         -CA "${CA}/ca.crt" \n#         -CAkey "${CA}/ca.key" \n#         -CAcreateserial \n#         -out "${TLS}/server.crt" \n#         -days 3650 \n#         -sha256

openssl ca -batch \n    -config "${CA}/openssl.cnf" \n    -keyfile "${CA}/ca.key" \n    -cert "${CA}/ca.crt" \n    -in "${TLS}/server.csr" \n    -out "${TLS}/server.crt" \n    -extfile "${TLS}/openssl.cnf" \n    -extensions v3_req \n    -create_serial \n    -startdate 20180101020000Z \n    -days 3650 

> ${CA}/index.txt

cp ${TLS}/server.key ${current_path}/conf/server_nopwd.key
cp ${TLS}/server.crt ${current_path}/conf/server.crt

# openssl x509 -in "${TLS}/server.crt"  -noout -text

record.rsp_body:
#!/bin/bash -xe
# The script is jenkins job to compile rpm packages for fitos.
# Jenkins Parameters:
# $FITOS_GIT_BRANCH: the branch for repository manifest
# $INCREMENTAL_COMPILE: incremental compile or not
# $PKG_LIST: package targets list to compile, empty to compile all
# $FH_DATE: compile time formated yyyyMMdd_HHmm
# Such as: http://10.132.3.10:8080/view/FitOS-CD/job/fitos-compile-rpm/
# The script must be executed at compile machine, such as 10.127.2.26

source /usr/local/bin/finishSetup.sh
openEuler_RPM_code=('python3_oslo_config' \n'python-cipherclient' \n'python-licenseclient' \n'python-monitorclient' \n'python-serviceclient' \n'update' \n'python3_oslo_messaging')

openEuler_RPM_spec=('recipes-base/python-oslo-config/euler/python3-oslo-config.spec' \n'recipes-fitos/python-cipherclient/euler/cipherclient.spec' \n'recipes-fitos/licenseclient/euler/licenseclient.spec' \n'recipes-fitos/python-monitorclient/euler/monitorclient.spec' \n'recipes-fitos/serviceclient/euler/serviceclient.spec' \n'recipes-fitos/cgcs-patch/euler/cgcs-patch.spec' \n'recipes-base/python-oslo-messaging/euler/python3-oslo-messaging.spec')

tis_patch_ver=`date +"%y%m%d"`
_tis_dist=.fitos.v5r3


if [ ! $INCREMENTAL_COMPILE ]; then
  INCREMENTAL_COMPILE=false
fi

if [[ $INCREMENTAL_COMPILE == false ]]; then
  # clean dir
  sudo rm -rf $MY_REPO_ROOT_DIR
  sudo rm -rf $MY_WORKSPACE
  mkdir -p $MY_REPO
  mkdir -p $MY_WORKSPACE

  # init repo manifest
  cd $MY_REPO_ROOT_DIR || exit 1
  repo init -u ssh://git@10.132.3.7:60022/fitcloud/manifest.git -b $FITOS_GIT_BRANCH -m default.xml --repo-url=ssh://git@10.132.3.7:60022/fitcloud/git-repo.git --no-repo-verify
fi

cd $MY_REPO_ROOT_DIR || exit 1
repo sync

#Insert CPU_ARCH to all spec files
if [ ! $CPU_ARCH ];then
	CPU_ARCH=x86_64
fi
find ./ -name '*.spec' | xargs sed -i '1 i\%define arch '"$CPU_ARCH"''

for i in ${openEuler_RPM_spec[@]}
    do
        sed -i 's/%{?_tis_dist}/'"$_tis_dist"'/g' $MY_REPO/stx/packages/openstack/$i
        sed -i 's/%{tis_patch_ver}/'"$tis_patch_ver"'/g' $MY_REPO/stx/packages/openstack/$i
    done

#Clean up rpmbuild/
ssh fh@10.150.2.132 << eeooff
rm -rf /home/fh/rpmbuild/SPECS/*
rm -rf /home/fh/rpmbuild/SOURCES/*
rm -rf /home/fh/rpmbuild/RPMS/*
rm -rf /home/fh/rpmbuild/SRPMS/*
rm -rf /home/fh/rpmbuild/BUILD/*
rm -rf /home/fh/rpmbuild/BUILDROOT/*
exit
eeooff

#Copy openEuler source code and spec files to 10.150.2.132
cd $MY_REPO/stx/git
for i in ${openEuler_RPM_code[@]}
    do
        tar -zcf $i.tar.gz $i
        scp $i.tar.gz fh@10.150.2.132:/home/fh/rpmbuild/SOURCES/
        rm -f $MY_REPO/stx/git/$i.tar.gz
    done

for i in ${openEuler_RPM_spec[@]}
    do
        scp $MY_REPO/stx/packages/openstack/$i fh@10.150.2.132:/home/fh/rpmbuild/SPECS/
        rm -f $MY_REPO/stx/packages/openstack/$i
    done

#build Centos RPMs
cd $MY_REPO_ROOT_DIR
build-pkgs $PKG_LIST
rm -rf ${MY_BUILD_DIR}/std/rpmbuild/RPMS/*.src.rpm

#build openEuler RPMs
ssh fh@10.150.2.132 << eeooff
set -o errexit
cd /home/fh/rpmbuild/SPECS/
rpmbuild -ba *
set +o errexit
exit
eeooff
if [[ $? -ne 0 ]];then
    exit 1
fi

# Copy RPMs to 10.132.3.4
if [ ! $FH_DATE ]; then
  FH_DATE=`date +%Y%m%d_%H%M`
fi

ssh -p60022 root@10.132.3.4 "rm -rf /vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE"
ssh -p60022 root@10.132.3.4 "mkdir -p /vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE/packages"
scp -P60022 ${MY_BUILD_DIR}/std/rpmbuild/RPMS/*.rpm root@10.132.3.4:/vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE/packages/
ssh fh@10.150.2.132 "scp -P60022 /home/fh/rpmbuild/RPMS/noarch/*.rpm root@10.132.3.4:/vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE/packages/"
ssh -p60022 root@10.132.3.4 "createrepo /vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE/"
ssh -p60022 root@10.132.3.4 "mkdir -p /vdd/fitos/3.6/branch/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/"
ssh -p60022 root@10.132.3.4 "ln -sfn /vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE/ /vdd/fitos/3.6/branch/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/fh-repo"
